card.name: The start of Pro- words in headings
card.fires_on: The word piece "Pro" that begins a longer word such as prophylaxis, prochlorperazine or proton, mostly at the start of a heading or list item in drug-label text.

modes.label: Prophylaxis headings
modes.description: "Pro" opens "phylaxis" in section titles about preventing a condition.

modes.label: Drug or class names
modes.description: "Pro" opens a drug name or class such as prochlorperazine or proton pump inhibitors.
